detail.longDescription: I'd like to reiterate, Agora is not # GNUstep . The only GNUstep code is a fork of their ObjC runtime. That is not a dig at GNUstep, it's a great project and should be an inspiration to us all. The Core Foundation library libagora-core is forked from Apple's public release of Core Foundation for Swift. The Foundation, AppKit, Core Text, and Core Graphics equivalent libraries are new. Toll-Free Bridging has been implemented in both directions, as well. # linux # freebsd # development # programming
